# idsec_pcloud_user (Resource)

Privilege Cloud User resource, manages AppProvider Vault users.
<!-- BEGIN CUSTOM NOTES -->
~> This resource is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is no longer the recommended way to manage Vault-native users.
<!-- END CUSTOM NOTES -->

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `initial_password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Initial password for the user (max 39 characters) Write-only: this value is never stored in Terraform state or plan. It is sent to the API on create, and on update whenever it changes; rotation is detected automatically via the computed `initial_password_write_only_hash` attribute, so no manual trigger needs to be bumped. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `location` (String) Vault location path for the user (e.g. \)
- `user_type` (String) Vault user type (e.g. AppProvider)
- `username` (String) Vault username

### Optional

- `change_pass_on_next_logon` (Boolean) Whether the user must change password on next logon
- `enable_user` (Boolean) Whether the user account is enabled
- `password_never_expires` (Boolean) Whether the user's password never expires

### Read-Only

- `initial_password_write_only_hash` (String, Sensitive) Automatically computed hash of initial_password. Changes when the secret changes; used to detect rotation without storing the raw value in state.
- `user_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the Vault user to update
